independentMeasurements.centralOpeningCaveat: The center is mostly open but not entirely alpha0: the exact generation prompt's fully empty central rectangle was not achieved. Candidate permission relies on low occupied fraction and requires device portrait visibility validation.

method: Viewed full source with view_image; read generation evidence; independently sampled alpha and compared runtime copy RGBA.
observations: Recognizable warm red/orange flame aura, no face or opaque central fire pillar. Large open center should allow artwork head and torso to remain readable.
Effective alpha silhouette has substantial outer padding; low-alpha colored pixels shown by viewer are not evidence of an opaque background.
Lower U-shaped base and two side strips remain comparatively thick. Device placement must keep the base clear of own HP/SP and preserve portrait visibility.
This is a single persistent status body, not a cast sheet. Existing dedicated rage icon remains the semantic status indicator.
acceptanceLimits: Candidate acceptance does not certify commercially finished appearance or device performance.
Verify body pulse, rotation with other active buffs, layer ordering, own HUD readability and cleanup on state expiry/death in real combat.
Reject if the flames paint a thick foreground band across the lower character or resource bars.
